interfaces.integration: Keep original pcurve reader first. Dispatch explicit prefix0 fallback only on failure. Postpass observed compact7-token selectors±1/±2 only with a qualified same-blob subtype catalog and parent topology. Preserve all unsupported diagnostics; no UV selected by coordinates or guessed inline record IDs.

grammar.explicit: Existing exp_par_cur/nubs degree1 or3 control grid, followed scalar, support definition, four optional finite support bounds, wrapper end and two explicit UV offsets. Every field is bounded and consumed exactly.
grammar.support: Exact spline/ref bracket or bounded version23100 sweep_sur/cyl_spl_sur/VBL_SURF inline block. Four support interval fields each have a Boolean plus optional double. Inline procedural bodies retained verbatim; this UV reader does not claim their geometry decoded. Explicit plane field grammar is supported but not present among the new outer-support cases in this four-file subset.
grammar.compact: Exactly7 typed fields: pointer-1,integer-1,pointer-1,nonzero integer selector,typed geometry pointer to intcurve,two stored offset doubles. Captured offsets are zero; nonzero compact offsets remain unsupported.
grammar.slot_identity: Owning coedge->edge.curve must equal the typed compact curve pointer. Reciprocal owning coedge ring and face loop chain establish parentface.surface. The blob-local subtype catalog resolves this surface and parent intcurve ordered support definitions to the same unique definition index. Only then must selector magnitude1/2 agree with ordered UV slot0/1.
grammar.sign: Both positive and negative selector values are captured. Sign is retained literally; no reversal, surface sense or curve-parameter transformation inferred.

limitations: Stored UV control caches are approximations; no direct API UV evaluator was captured. Independent polynomial checks validate decoding/evaluation of those stored fields only.

The compact parent identity requires a namespace-qualified spline support. Direct plane-only support identity and ambiguous repeated support identities are rejected; matching plane coordinates is not a substitute.
Opaque inline procedural surface definitions are strictly bracket/version/bounds framed and replayable but not procedurally evaluated by this reader.
Inline allocation numbers, geometry record pointers, global inspection indices and native Design object IDs are separate namespaces.
Nonzero compact offsets, rational UV controls, unobserved degrees/forms/selectors, missing parent UV slots and unresolved namespace or topology remain unsupported.
